name: Eagles Rec Camp
street_address: Margot Connell Recreation Center, 140 Commonwealth Avenue
description_short: Weekly day camp at Boston College's recreation center where campers ages 7 to 12 rotate through gym games, sports and crafts, swim daily in the pool and end each week with a camp wide Friday celebration.
refund_policy_summary: 60 or more days before camp: refund minus a 20% fee; 30 to 59 days: 50% refund; under 30 days: no refund except documented medical issues.
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily pool time with certified lifeguards; campers who pass the swim test can use the diving board.

sessions.name: Session III (4 days, Tue to Fri)

notes: 2027 registration opened November 4, 2026 (November 3 for returning campers). Camp 8:15 am to 3:00 pm; optional extended day 3:00 to 5:00 pm for $125 a week ($100 for the 4 day week, $115 or $90 BC affiliated). BC affiliated camp price is $390 a week ($312 for the 4 day week) with a valid BC ID. No camp Monday July 5. 60 campers per session. Drop off at the northwest corner of the Margot Connell Recreation Center; park in the Beacon Street Garage.
